notes.subject: זרמתם
notes.rationale: 'yu rausim ol i go olsem wara i pulap long pait' (KJV/ASV/JPS) o 'yu pulim ol long slip' (BSB — i rid זְרַמְתָּם wantaim שֵׁנָה olsem wanpela sentens)

notes.subject: יחלף
notes.rationale: חלף i min 'i go pas we' o 'i gro antap'; KJV 'groweth up', YLT 'changeth'

translation: Yu rausim ol i go olsem wara i pulap long pait; ol i olsem slip; long moningtaim ol i olsem graun gras i gro we antap.

tokens.gloss: yu rausim ol i go olsem wara i pulap long pait
